summary: Iter34/35 E2E validation: scheduled_local wall-clock, robust gig date formatting, and 'Available Now' worker toggle. 9/9 backend pytest pass and all frontend flows verified via Playwright.
verified_features: POST /api/gigs with scheduled_local persists and GET returns it intact (test_gig_stores_scheduled_local PASS)
Recurring weekly gigs: every occurrence's scheduled_date contains '9:00 AM' (UTC drift bug fixed; test_recurring_uses_wall_clock_for_display PASS)
PUT /api/me/availability ON sets available_now+future available_until; OFF clears both; custom hours=2 supported; admin (non-worker) blocked with 403
GET /api/auth/me reflects current available_now and available_until
GET /api/admin/workers?available_now=true filter returns only flipped-on workers; admin-only (worker gets 403)
Backward-compat: single + recurring gig POST without scheduled_local still works (test_iter35_backcompat 2/2 PASS)
/ops dashboard: 'dashboard-available-strip' appears when >=1 worker available; text 'X worker(s) are available right now'; click navigates to /ops/workers?status=approved
/ops/workers: filter-available-now toggle present and clickable; when active, only available workers shown; each card shows AVAILABLE NOW badge (available-badge-{user_id})
Admin gig detail 'Add a worker' dialog: shows '1 AVAILABLE NOW' counter (data-testid='available-now-count') and pins available workers at top with assign-available-{user_id} badge
Admin gig detail When row uses formatGigLong ('Monday, June 29 · 4:07 PM – 8:07 PM (4h)') with 'Starts in 14 days' relative
Admin gig list 'When' column uses formatGigShort ('Sat, Jan 31 · 9:00 AM')

Worker /crew feed: AvailableNowToggle present for approved workers; click ON shows green 'You're available right now' card with 'Until X' label (data-testid='available-until') and ON pill; click OFF removes the until element
Worker /crew feed gig cards: feed-when-{gig_id} test ids render formatGigShort ('Thu Dec 31 · 5 AM – 9 AM')
Worker /crew/gigs/{id}: gig-when-value='Thursday, December 31 · 5 AM – 9 AM (4h)' (formatGigLong); gig-when-relative='Starts in 7 months' (formatGigRelative)
Public /gigs/{id} page: uses formatGigLong; no raw timestamps visible
critical_code_review_comments: AvailableNowToggle 'Until' label shows '3:59 AM' for a worker because PUT /me/availability with no body defaults to end-of-day in America/New_York site time, but the FRONTEND renders that ISO string in the browser's local TZ. For a tester in UTC, 'end of ET day (Mon 23:59 EDT)' becomes 03:59 UTC next morning. Functionally correct, but might confuse workers in non-ET timezones. Consider always rendering this label in the same site TZ (America/New_York) used to compute the expiry, for consistency.
Public gig share page is fully accessible without auth (verified) — no PII leaked, just title/category/location-city/date/payment. OK.

Pending/rejected/suspended worker no-toggle behaviour could not be exercised end-to-end via /auth/register because registration auto-approves the user (worker_status='approved' in the response). The null-return guard exists in AvailableNowToggle.jsx and was code-reviewed only — not runtime-verified. Recommend a backend admin endpoint or DB seed step to flip a worker to 'pending' for future regression tests.

rca of the issue: Original Calendar timezone bug RCA (fixed in this iteration, validated here): recurring gig generator called strftime on a UTC-aware datetime to build the scheduled_date display string, so an admin posting 9 AM EST got the first occurrence's display correct (server echoed admin payload), but subsequent generated occurrences serialized the UTC moment (14:00) which rendered as '2:00 PM'. Fix: introduced scheduled_local 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm' wall-clock field as the single source of truth; recurring loop computes future occurrences by adding 7-day deltas to that wall-clock string. Frontend now reads scheduled_local first via /app/frontend/src/lib/gigDate.js. Verified: 3-occurrence weekly series all contain '9:00 AM' in scheduled_date.
